prompt:
Draw EXACTLY8 complete Darklight Requiem GAME SPRITES on transparent background,2rows4columns. Reference1 is a full-body walking pose guide ONLY, not costume, not proportions. Reference2 the approved Requiem LEFT VIEW is authority for style/face/brown hair/proportions/black sleeved long coat/gauntlets/greaves. Reference3 is Rock skin costume (sleeveless vest/skull shirt/bare upper arms); keep same character head. Reference4 only eyes/skin. Keep approved young compact 3-head-tall body, not adult mannequin proportions.

ALL8 strictly LEFT/WEST profile, normal relaxed WALK, low knees, short natural stride, low relaxed arm pendulum, hands beside thighs. Small dark carmine aura. Silver/dark steel clawed gauntlets and greaves unchanged, warm peach skin, red irises. No blade/scythe, no color-coded orange/blue limbs, no floor/labels. All black clothes. Camera fixed. All head/body/equipment fully visible, same scale/baseline, generous transparent gutters. Crisp approved sprite style.

TOP ROW = 4 successive WALK keyframes of REQUIEM; BOTTOM ROW = identical gait phases of ROCK. Match these FOUR full-body guide poses from Reference1:
col1 = guide TOP LEFT: near ORANGE leg FORWARD LEFT heel contact; far BLUE leg BACK RIGHT toe support; NEAR ARM BACK RIGHT.
col2 = guide TOP row SECOND: near leg supports under/just forward of hip; far foot passing from rear, low off ground; near arm approaching center.
col3 = guide BOTTOM LEFT: near ORANGE leg BACK RIGHT toe support; far BLUE leg FORWARD LEFT heel contact; NEAR ARM FORWARD LEFT. This must visibly exchange near/far leg overlap compared with col1, not redraw same leading leg.
col4 = guide BOTTOM row SECOND: far leg supporting under hip; near leg swings past ankle from rear; near arm returning toward center.
The guide colors ONLY distinguish limbs. In final art use normal black/steel, no orange/blue. Follow gait anatomy from guide rather than guard pose from costume reference. No high-knee martial march or fighting stance. Never collage or cut body parts: draw every figure newly and intact.
